daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿أَتى أَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَلا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive; the imperfect verb is jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أسبح"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَعالى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ mā is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) سبحان. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يُنَزِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِالرُّوحِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينزل. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ man is a relative noun; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to ينزل. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ﴾ the lightened (mukhaffafa) an; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), badal (substitute) of الروح. ﴿أَنْذِرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna and its noun; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, operating like inna. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa; the khabar is omitted; the clause is the khabar of أنه. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنَا﴾ badal of the pronoun in the omitted khabar. ﴿فَاتَّقُونِ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa) and an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); the yāʾ of the first person was deleted for lightness, and it is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and السموات is its object, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَعالى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ عن is a preposition and mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to تعالى; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿خَلَقَ الْإِنْسانَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and الإنسان is its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خلق. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) and إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُوَ خَصِيمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:5-7.t: ﴿وَالْأَنْعامَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and الأنعام is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الإنسان. ﴿خَلَقَها﴾ a past verb and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقها; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. ﴿فِيها دِفْءٌ﴾ دفء is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿وَمَنافِعُ﴾ conjoined to دفء. ﴿وَمِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأكلون. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَكُمْ فِيها جَمالٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; جمال is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حِينَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of جمال. ﴿تُرِيحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to the one before it, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقالَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; أثقالكم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى بَلَدٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تحمل. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle of jussive, negation and conversion [of tense] (qalb). ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb and the wāw is its noun; the clause is a naʿt of بلد. ﴿بالِغِيهِ﴾ khabar, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِشِقِّ الْأَنْفُسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; الأنفس is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَرَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ the two khabars of inna, both nominative, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:8-10.t: ﴿وَالْخَيْلَ﴾ conjoined to الأنعام. ﴿وَالْبِغالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿لِتَرْكَبُوها﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقها. ﴿وَزِينَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "جعلها زينة" (He made them an adornment), and it is conjoined. ﴿وَيَخْلُقُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by على; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to the khabar (predicate) of قصد. ﴿قَصْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; the clause is resumptive. ﴿السَّبِيلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمِنْها جائِرٌ﴾ جائر is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "منها سبيل جائر" (of them is a deviating path); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ﴾ [الله]: a past verb and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَهَداكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to law, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is its object. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, khabar. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شراب. ﴿شَرابٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَمِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿شَجَرٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسيمون. ﴿تُسِيمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of شجر.

daas-irab:11-13.t: ﴿يُنْبِتُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينبت. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينبت. ﴿الزَّرْعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالزَّيْتُونَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الزرع. ﴿وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْأَعْنابَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَمِنْ كُلِّ﴾ conjoined to what has gone before. ﴿الثَّمَراتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً﴾ inna; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted khabar (predicate); ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; آية is the noun of inna, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية. ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سخر. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾ conjoined to الليل. ﴿وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّراتٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسخرات. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ inna, a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿لَآياتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the shifted lām, and آيات is the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound masculine feminine [plural] [Translator's note: the source reads «مؤنث مذكر سالم» as written; a sound feminine plural (jamʿ muʾannath sālim) is evidently meant]; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of آيات; and the clause يتفكرون is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of قوم. [Translator's note: the verb in this verse is يعقلون; the source writes يتفكرون, carried over from the previous verse.] ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is a relative. ﴿ذَرَأَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذرأ. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذرأ. ﴿مُخْتَلِفاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَلْوانُهُ﴾ fāʿil of مختلف. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ see the i'rab of the end of the two preceding verses; this verse is resumptive.

daas-irab:14-16.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; هو is mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and البحر is its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِتَأْكُلُوا﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the wāw is the fāʿil; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) سخر. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأكلوا. ﴿لَحْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿طَرِيًّا﴾ naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا﴾ an imperfect verb and the wāw is its fāʿil; it is conjoined to تأكلوا and accusative like it, by the deletion of the nūn. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تستخرجوا. ﴿حِلْيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَلْبَسُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt of حلية. ﴿وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and الفلك is its object; the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مَواخِرَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مواخر. ﴿وَلِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of لتأكلوا, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مواخر. ﴿وَلِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of لتأكلوا, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبتغوا. [Translator's note: the source repeats ﴿وَلِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ twice, the first time attaching من فضله to مواخر and the second time to تبتغوا; both are translated as written.] ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لعل, and the kāf is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعل. ﴿وَأَلْقى فِي الْأَرْضِ رَواسِيَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ألقى; رواسي is a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, its implied form being "جبالا رواسي" (firm mountains). ﴿أَنْ تَمِيدَ﴾ an, the particle of the subjunctive (al-nāṣiba), and تميد is an imperfect verb, accusative. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تميد; an and what follows it are in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to its shaking". ﴿وَأَنْهاراً وَسُبُلًا﴾ conjoined to رواسي. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ﴾ its i'rab has already been given. ﴿عَلاماتٍ﴾ conjoined to رواسي and accusative like it. ﴿وَبِالنَّجْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يهتدون. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:17-20.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and man is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كَمَنْ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and man is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of man. ﴿لا يَخْلُقُ﴾ lā is negating and يخلق is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. [Translator's note: there is no relative here for this clause to be a ṣila of; the source says "ṣila" as written.] ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and in is conditional. ﴿تَعُدُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the conditional sentence is resumptive, and the clause of the protasis is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿نِعْمَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا تُحْصُوها﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; غفور and رحيم are its two khabars, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿تُسِرُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما تُعْلِنُونَ﴾ conjoined to the one before it, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يدعون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَخْلُقُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial) and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَخْلُقُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar, and the clause هم is a ḥāl clause.

daas-irab:21-24.t: ﴿أَمْواتٌ﴾ khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم أموات" (they are dead); the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of أموات. ﴿أَحْياءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَيَّانَ﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adverb of time. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause أيان يبعثون is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلهُكُمْ إِلهٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿واحِدٌ﴾ naʿt; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَالَّذِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and الذين is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the sentence of mubtadaʾ and khabar is resumptive. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤمنون. ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُنْكِرَةٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَهُمْ مُسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لا جَرَمَ﴾ it means "it is true and established" (ḥaqqa wa-thabata), a past verb, and what follows it — inna, its noun and its khabar — stands in place of the fāʿil. [Translator's note: the particle that follows is أنّ (anna); the source writes «إن» as written.] ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil of يعلم is latent (mustatir). ﴿يُسِرُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾ its i'rab is like the one before it, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يُحِبُّ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi, and the nāʾib fāʿil is the clause ماذا أنزل ربكم. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قيل. ﴿ماذا﴾ mā is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and dhā is a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of speech. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾ khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي". ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of speech.

daas-irab:25-26.t: ﴿لِيَحْمِلُوا﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); يحملوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the lām and what follows it are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قالوا; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوْزارَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كامِلَةً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْ أَوْزارِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أوزارهم. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُضِلُّونَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the hāʾ. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿ساءَ﴾ a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَزِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَكَرَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿فَأَتَى﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) owing to impossibility. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿بُنْيانَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْقَواعِدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتى; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خر. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَتاهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾ a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ حيث is indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive by min; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to أتاهم. ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ lā is negating; يشعرون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:27-29.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُخْزِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَيَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَيْنَ شُرَكائِيَ﴾ شركائي is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; أين is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative, naʿt (adjective) of شركائي. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿تُشَاقُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تشاقون. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and العلم and its object [Translator's note: the source reads «والعلم ومفعوله» as written; العلم is evidently meant as its (second) object]; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to الخزي. ﴿وَالسُّوءَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الخزي. ﴿عَلَى الْكافِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar; the clause is the object of speech. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, naʿt of الكافرين. ﴿تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿ظالِمِي﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the nūn was deleted for the construct (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَأَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to the ṣila clause. ﴿ما كُنَّا﴾ the negating mā; كنا is kāna and its noun; the clause is the object of speech of an omitted verb, its implied form being "يقولون" (they say) ... etc. ﴿نَعْمَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of كنا. ﴿مِنْ سُوءٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and سوء is mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of reply. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun and عليم its khabar; the clause is the object of speech of an omitted verb, namely "قالوا بلى" (they said: yes indeed). ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to عليم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم. ﴿فَادْخُلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَبْوابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خالدين. ﴿فَلَبِئْسَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ), and بئس is a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿مَثْوَى﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:30-31.t: ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ماذا﴾ mā is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and dhā is a relative noun, khabar (predicate); the clause is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أنزل خيرا" (He sent down good), and it is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ الذين is a relative noun, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿أَحْسَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and ذه is a demonstrative in the position of genitive; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to أحسنوا. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, in the position of genitive. ﴿حَسَنَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَدارُ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ) and دار is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَنِعْمَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of inception, and نعم is a past verb for expressing praise (inshāʾ al-madḥ). ﴿دارُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾ khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَدْخُلُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَشاؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَجْزِي اللَّهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and المتقين its object; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:32-33.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿طَيِّبِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين. ﴿سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of speech. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to ادخلوا. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.
[Translator's note: from this point to the end of the entry the source's markup is corrupted — the opening brackets and first letters of the Quranic words are fused onto the preceding line (e.g. «خبرَلْ»», «حرف استفهامَ نْظُرُونَ»»). The Quranic words below are restored from the muṣḥaf; the analyses are translated as written.]
﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ an is the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba), and an imperfect verb, accusative, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوْ يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ﴾ aw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to what precedes it; أمر is the fāʿil. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, and the two [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَعَلَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating, and a past verb, its fronted object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَظْلِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:34-35.t: ﴿فَأَصابَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fronted object. ﴿سَيِّئاتُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَحاقَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) حاق. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, fāʿil of حاق. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿وَقالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb; الذين is a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿ما عَبَدْنا﴾ mā is negating, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عبدنا. ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil of عبدنا. ﴿وَلا آباؤُنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is redundant, and آباؤنا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to نحن; نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا حَرَّمْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb حرمنا. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, genitive by the kāf, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿هل﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿عَلَى الرُّسُلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ naʿt of بلاغ.

daas-irab:36-37.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the omitted oath clause is conjoined, and the clause of the response to the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿بَعَثْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بعثنا. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أَنِ﴾ explicative (mufassira). ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَدَى اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ﴾ منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar, and man is a relative, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلالَةُ﴾ a past verb, and الضلالة is its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حقت. ﴿فَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سيروا. ﴿فَانْظُرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, the khabar of kāna placed before it. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of انظروا. ﴿الْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. ﴿إِنْ﴾ the conditional [in]. ﴿تَحْرِصْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿عَلى هُداهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تحرص; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لا يَهْدِي﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُضِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿ناصِرِينَ﴾ [its] noun, genitive in form, accusative in position; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:38-40.t: ﴿وَأَقْسَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقسموا. ﴿جَهْدَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "striving". ﴿أَيْمانِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ مَنْ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and the relative noun is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the oath. ﴿يَمُوتُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of reply. ﴿وَعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to وعدا. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna and its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of lākinna. ﴿لِيُبَيِّنَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to the verb that comes after بلى. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يبين. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يختلفون. ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ﴾ conjoined to ليبين, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, fāʿil. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun; the maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of يعلم. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the khabar of أنهم. ﴿كاذِبِينَ﴾ khabar of كانوا, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿قَوْلُنا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِشَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قولنا. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَرَدْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ نَقُولَ﴾ an is the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba), and an imperfect verb, accusative; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative as khabar. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقول. ﴿كُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperative verb whose fāʿil is omitted; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and يكون is a complete imperfect verb whose fāʿil is نحن; the implied sense is "so We say that to it, and it is". [Translator's note: the source gives the fāʿil of يكون as «نحن» (We) as written; the subject of يكون would ordinarily be a latent third-person pronoun («هو») referring to the thing.]

daas-irab:41-43.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and الذين is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هاجَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by في; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) هاجروا. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما﴾ the maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) [mā]. ﴿ظُلِمُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in construct with بعد. ﴿لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is its first object; the sentence composed of the oath and its response is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ الذين. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نبوئنهم. ﴿حَسَنَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَأَجْرُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ), and أجر is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the response of law is omitted. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, badal (substitute) of the الذين before it. ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوكلون. ﴿يَتَوَكَّلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رِجالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نُوحِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نوحي. ﴿فَسْئَلُوا أَهْلَ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿الذِّكْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause has no grammatical position, being initial. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of kāna, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:44-46.t: ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿وَالزُّبُرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to البينات. ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا إِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزلنا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِتُبَيِّنَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to أنزلنا. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبين. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نُزِّلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. [Translator's note: the nāʾib fāʿil is ordinarily described here as a latent pronoun referring to ما; the source says "omitted" as written.] ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نزل; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لعل and its noun; the clause is conjoined, and the clause يتفكرون is the khabar (predicate). ﴿أَفَأَمِنَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَكَرُوا السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنْ يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ﴾ an, the particle of the subjunctive (al-nāṣiba), and an imperfect verb, accusative; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and الأرض its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يخسف; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أمن. ﴿أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذابُ﴾ aw, the conjunction, and a conjoined imperfect verb, accusative with the fatḥa, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to يأتيهم. ﴿لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, [accusative] with the fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿هُمْ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِمُعْجِزِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); معجزين is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:47-50.t: ﴿أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى تَخَوُّفٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; inna, its noun and its two khabars (predicates), and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the wāw is resumptive, and lam is the jussive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلى ما﴾ mā is a relative, and the two [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يروا. ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿يَتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلالُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of شيء. [Translator's note: the source says "its object" as written; no object is overtly expressed in these words.] ﴿عَنِ الْيَمِينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتفيؤوا. ﴿وَالشَّمائِلِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to سجدا. ﴿وَهُمْ داخِرُونَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لله: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to يسجد. ﴿يَسْجُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿ما﴾ a relative, fāʿil. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿مِنْ دابَّةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ conjoined to ما. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl and هم is mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿يَخافُونَ رَبَّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, ربهم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يستكبرون. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from ربهم; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَفْعَلُونَ﴾ conjoined to يخافون. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُؤْمَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:51-53.t: ﴿وَقالَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تَتَّخِذُوا﴾ lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِلهَيْنِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ naʿt (adjective), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿هُوَ إِلهٌ واحِدٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and واحد is a naʿt of the khabar; the clause is one of causation (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِيَّايَ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and إياي is a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb ارهبون. ﴿فَارْهَبُونِ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); the yāʾ of the first person was deleted for lightness. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes. ﴿وَلَهُ الدِّينُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿واصِباً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and غير is a fronted mafʿūl bihi; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما بِكُمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is conditional, mubtadaʾ; بكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, and من نعمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; فمن الله: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and من الله — the Name of Majesty is genitive by min, [the preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted khabar, its implied form being "هو من الله" (it is from Allah); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the khabar of mā is the two clauses of the condition. ﴿ثُمَّ إِذا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ﴾ thumma is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition; إذا مسكم الضر: a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined, and the clause مسكم is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تجأرون. ﴿تَجْئَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to إذا.

daas-irab:54-56.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ﴾ a past verb and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) كشف. ﴿إِذا﴾ the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فريق. ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كشف. [Translator's note: the source says «كشف» as written; بربهم is evidently attached to يشركون.] ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِيَكْفُرُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the wāw is the fāʿil; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to يشركون. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to يكفروا. ﴿آتَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَتَمَتَّعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and sawfa is a particle of futurity. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيَجْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِما﴾ mā is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to يجعلون. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn. ﴿نَصِيباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ the relative mā is genitive by min, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to an omitted naʿt of نصيبا. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the oath, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to the omitted verb أقسم (I swear). ﴿لَتُسْئَلُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative; its nūn was deleted owing to the dislike of a succession of identical letters, and the deleted wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ mā is a relative, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تسألن. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تَفْتَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:57-59.t: ﴿وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ الْبَناتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجعلون. ﴿الْبَناتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of nominative, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَشْتَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial), and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْأُنْثى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بشر. ﴿ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا﴾ ظل, its noun and its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿يَتَوارى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to heaviness; the clause is a ḥāl clause. [Translator's note: the source says "owing to heaviness" (lil-thiqal) as written; on an alif the ḍamma is normally said to be implied owing to impossibility (lil-taʿadhdhur).] ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوارى. ﴿مِنْ سُوءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوارى. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بُشِّرَ﴾ a passive past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil is omitted; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بشر. ﴿أَيُمْسِكُهُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl clause. [Translator's note: the pronoun in يمسكه is a hāʾ; the source writes «الكاف» as written.] ﴿عَلى هُونٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يمسكه. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَدُسُّهُ﴾ conjoined to يمسكه; it is an imperfect verb, nominative, the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِي التُّرابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يدسه. ﴿أَلا﴾ an opening particle (istiftāḥ). ﴿ساءَ ما﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَحْكُمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:60-61.t: ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤمنون. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّوْءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَثَلُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾ naʿt (adjective), nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ naʿt; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿يُؤاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and الناس its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِظُلْمِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤاخذ. ﴿ما تَرَكَ﴾ mā is negating, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), genitive in form, accusative in position. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤخرهم. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿ساعَةً﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time, attached to يستأخرون. ﴿وَلا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:62-63.t: ﴿وَيَجْعَلُونَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجعلون. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَكْرَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنى﴾ anna and its postponed noun, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is badal (substitute) of الكذب. ﴿لا جَرَمَ﴾ a verb meaning "it is established" (thabata). ﴿أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ﴾ anna and its postponed noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted khabar; the clause is in the position of nominative as fāʿil of جرم. ﴿وَأَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مُفْرَطُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative with the wāw. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is a preposition and particle of oath, and the Name of Majesty is in the position of genitive by the tāʾ; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to the verb أقسم (I swear); the oath clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the response to the oath. ﴿إِلى أُمَمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمم. ﴿فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to زين; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ naʿt of عذاب.

daas-irab:64-65.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتابَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿لِتُبَيِّنَ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); an and what follows it are attached to أرسلنا. [Translator's note: the verb in this verse is أنزلنا; the source writes «أرسلنا» as written.] ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبين. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اختلفوا. ﴿وَهُدىً﴾ conjoined to the position of لتبين. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾ conjoined to هدى. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَحْيا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أحيا is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحيا. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to أحيا. ﴿مَوْتِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the noun of inna. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of آية. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of قوم.

daas-irab:66-67.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna, which resembles the verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي الْأَنْعامِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَعِبْرَةً﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); عبرة is the postponed noun of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نُسْقِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its first object; the clause is resumptive, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ mā is a relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to نسقيكم. ﴿فِي بُطُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نسقيكم. ﴿فَرْثٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَدَمٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لَبَناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿خالِصاً سائِغاً﴾ two naʿts (adjectives) of لبنا. ﴿لِلشَّارِبِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سائغا. ﴿وَمِنْ ثَمَراتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb after them. ﴿النَّخِيلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَعْنابِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿تَتَّخِذُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تتخذون. ﴿سَكَراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَرِزْقاً﴾ conjoined to سكرا. ﴿حَسَناً﴾ naʿt; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾ the shifted lām; آية is the noun of inna. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of آية; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم.

daas-irab:68-69.t: ﴿وَأَوْحى﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿أَوْحى﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَى النَّحْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحى. ﴿أَنِ﴾ an explicative particle (ḥarf tafsīr). ﴿اتَّخِذِي﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the yāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is explicative (mufassira), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْجِبالِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اتخذي. ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾ min, and mā is a relative; conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَعْرِشُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كُلِي﴾ an imperative verb, and the yāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كلي. ﴿الثَّمَراتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاسْلُكِي﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the yāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿سُبُلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبِّكِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذُلُلًا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَخْرُجُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿مِنْ بُطُونِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرج; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَرابٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُخْتَلِفٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of شراب. ﴿أَلْوانُهُ﴾ fāʿil of مختلف; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿شِفاءٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شفاء; the clause is a second naʿt of شراب. ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآيَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ see its i'rab in the previous verse.

daas-irab:70-71.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَمِنْكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative, postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُرَدُّ﴾ a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلى أَرْذَلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرد. ﴿الْعُمُرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِكَيْ لا﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), kay is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and lā is negating. ﴿يَعْلَمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by kay, whose fāʿil is latent; the lām and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) after it are attached to يرد. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to يعلم. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم and قدير are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فضل. ﴿فِي الرِّزْقِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَمَا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and mā operates like laysa. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as the noun of mā; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فُضِّلُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِرَادِّي﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and رادي is the khabar of mā, genitive in form with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the nūn was deleted for the construct (iḍāfa). ﴿رِزْقِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to رادي. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سواء. ﴿سَواءٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive; بنعمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يجحدون. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَجْحَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive.

daas-irab:72-73.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل. ﴿مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعل; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa), and its i'rab is like the one before it. ﴿مِنْ أَزْواجِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعل. ﴿بَنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ. ﴿وَحَفَدَةً﴾ conjoined to بنين. ﴿وَرَزَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رزقكم. ﴿أَفَبِالْباطِلِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤمنون. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَبِنِعْمَتِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يكفرون. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, in the position of genitive by the construct (iḍāfa). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَيَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَمْلِكُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يملك. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رزق. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of رزقا. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:74-75.t: ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَضْرِبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) تضربوا. ﴿الْأَمْثالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating; تعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أنتم. ﴿ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا﴾ a past verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and مثلا its object. ﴿عَبْداً﴾ badal (substitute) of مثلا. ﴿مَمْلُوكاً﴾ naʿt (adjective); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يَقْدِرُ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a second naʿt of عبدا. ﴿عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقدر. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; man is conjoined to عبدا, and man is a relative noun. ﴿رَزَقْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رزقناه. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَناً﴾ naʿt. ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; هو is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يُنْفِقُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينفق. ﴿سِرًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَجَهْراً﴾ conjoined to سرا. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:76-77.t: ﴿وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا﴾ its i'rab has already been given; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿رَجُلَيْنِ﴾ badal (substitute) of مثلا. ﴿أَحَدُهُما أَبْكَمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of رجلين. ﴿لا يَقْدِرُ﴾ lā is negating, and يقدر is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقدر; the clause is a naʿt of أبكم. ﴿وَهُوَ كَلٌّ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial), and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿عَلى مَوْلاهُ﴾ على is a preposition; مولى is a noun, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to كل. ﴿أَيْنَما﴾ a non-jussive conditional noun, an adverb of place attached to what follows it. [Translator's note: أينما is a jussive conditional noun — it makes يوجهه and يأت jussive, as the source itself goes on to say; the source writes «غير جازم» (non-jussive) as written.] ﴿يُوَجِّهْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); its fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by the construct (iḍāfa). ﴿لا يَأْتِ﴾ lā is negating; يأت is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿بِخَيْرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأت. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿هُوَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun, conjoined to the latent pronoun in يستوي. ﴿يَأْمُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْعَدْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأمر. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl; هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى صِراطٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ naʿt of صراط; the clause is a ḥāl clause. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لله: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿غَيْبُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā is negating. ﴿أَمْرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿السَّاعَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَلَمْحِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْبَصَرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿هُوَ أَقْرَبُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of inna; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:78-79.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَخْرَجَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ بُطُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرجكم. ﴿أُمَّهاتِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جعل. ﴿السَّمْعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْأَبْصارَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السمع. ﴿وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn;
